item.title: Cardinal Dolan: Vance ‘apologized’ for ‘out of line’ comments about US bishops and immigration

item.title: ICE ‘mega centers’ for mass detention ‘challenge the conscience,’ says USCCB bishop
item.description: “The thought of holding thousands of families in massive warehouses should challenge the conscience of every American. item.title: St. Francis’ relics open to public for first extended veneration in 800 years
item.description: The bones of the beloved saint were unveiled for public display Feb. 22 in the Lower Church of the Basilica of St. Francis of Assisi. Pilgrims waited in line outside of the Assisi basilica, taking in the panoramic views of the Umbrian countryside from the medieval hilltop town, for their chance to pray before the relics.
